repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability dashboard for tracking the performance and financial cost of AI coding agents.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based local dashboard designed to ingest logs from Claude Code, Codex, and similar agents.
Purpose: Provides granular visibility into agentic workflows by breaking down tasks into specific steps, file changes, and tool usage.
Use Cases: Financial auditing of LLM token spend, debugging agentic reasoning loops, and measuring developer productivity gains.
Key Feature: Calculates real-time cost-per-task, allowing teams to optimize prompt engineering and model selection for cost efficiency.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: EthanXiang777/circuit-framework
repos.description: Circuit Framework — multi-agent LLM trading research system
repos.one_liner: A specialized multi-agent framework designed specifically for LLM-driven quantitative trading research.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based architecture utilizing multi-agent orchestration to handle complex financial data pipelines.
Purpose: Automates the research lifecycle for trading strategies, from hypothesis generation to backtesting and signal validation.
Use Cases: Developing algorithmic trading strategies, conducting automated market research, and testing alpha signals.
Key Feature: Modular agent design allows for the separation of data retrieval, strategy logic, and risk management components.

repos.one_liner: A high-performance, local-first dashboard for A-share market sentiment analysis and short-term trading review.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based dashboard utilizing local computation for derived market metrics without relying on external AI for core calculations.
Purpose: Provides a real-time view of market liquidity, sentiment cycles, and stock momentum for A-share traders.
Use Cases: Daily market review, identifying 'money-making' effects in the market, and tracking sector rotation.
Key Feature: Uses AI only for synthesizing data into readable insights, ensuring high-speed performance and privacy by running entirely locally.

repos.name: Flaminis/Dalaran
repos.description: Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.
repos.one_liner: A robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure tool for multimodal time-series data, built as a high-performance fork of Rerun.
bullets: Written in Rust, optimized for high-throughput ingestion and visualization of time-series data.
Native ROS 2 support allows for seamless integration into existing robotics and automated data pipelines.
Designed to handle complex, multi-sensor data streams with low latency, making it suitable for high-frequency trading backtesting or sensor fusion.
Provides a robust framework for replaying and analyzing historical data recordings (.rrd files) with advanced visual inspection.
